dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: It might be more exciting if we had made the rail tilt a little more... It's about the rotation angle in the air... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Haddo
dialogues.text: It's you... *cough* Enjoying your days in the Veluriyam Mirage?

choices.text: We've had a lot of fun!

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: That's good... *cough* It's good to hear that you're having a good time.

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: Oh, speaking of which... *cough* Would you like to try one of these test mini-carts?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Test? Do carts even need to be tested?

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: Yeah. See the site behind me? That's where Choo-Choo Carts are tested. Hehe, do you remember the Torrential Twister?

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: This is where that rail line was born... *cough* Even with the Preprint and the Streaming Projector, a properly designed route is essential to the whole process.

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: So it's important that we design and test the rails in advance so we can collect feedback for future iterations... Right now it's just... just more or less... what Jeroney calls "overstimulating."

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: The test site for small carts has three rails for gradient testing. *cough* Choo-Choo Carts can go a bit faster on these rails...

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: They are called... *cough* "Meh, It's Okay Rail," "Kinda Dizzy Now Rail," and "Aaaah! Please Slow Down Rail." Oh, if you're wondering, Ferdinand came up with the names.

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: He's alright. He just needs some, um, fresh air...

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: Anyway, since all three are faster than... *cough* All three tests are faster than the rails outside, so I recommend that you begin with the "Meh, It's Okay Rail."

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: Whaddaya say? Brave enough to give it a go?

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: I like your confidence! Go find the Hydro Eidolon in charge of the three test rails. It'll be happy to activate the test for you.

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: No hurry. *cough* The Hydro Eidolon in charge of the three test rails is always there. Feel free to come test whenever you've got time...

response.speaker: Haddo
response.text: *cough* I'm not expecting it to get better. But it's alright, a cough can't stop my passion for designing tracks...
